working_title: Dance With Dad! | Father's Day Animal Song for Kids
audience: children ages 3 to 7 and their families
format: original lively call-and-response Father's Day animal song

music.scene_grid: six bars / twelve seconds per scene
music.style: bright marimba, brass pops, acoustic bass, hand drums, claps and a warm children's chorus
music.arc: invitation, five accumulating animal-dad dance verses, full parade chorus, affectionate dance-party finale
music.rule: real claps, stomps, slides, drums and jumps are synchronized effects; no voice imitates an effect word

motion_direction.transition_family: hard cuts and action-matched moves on four-beat phrases
motion_direction.motion_hierarchy: one dad-child dance action is the hero; partner reactions support; bunting and leaves remain ambient
motion_direction.camera_rule: one move per shot, normally a short eased follow or push; camera movement never substitutes for the dance action
motion_direction.hold_rule: each action lands and holds for at least one half-beat before the next accent

visual_system.style: premium integrated full-frame tactile 3D storybook animation with warm daylight, dimensional fur and fabric, and consistent sunny festival-park geography
visual_system.frame: 1920x1080 landscape, 12-column grid, 100-pixel outer margin, faces and title-safe content inside five percent
visual_system.palette: sky blue, marigold, coral, leaf green and warm cream
visual_system.production_method: each verse receives identity-locked integrated anticipation and action-state frames with matched camera and lighting; animate the physical action between those states

chorus: Dance with Dad, come dance with me!
Side by side, we laugh and play.
Hooray for Dads on Father's Day!

scenes.cast: all five animal children preparing the sunny park while their dads arrive through the bunting arch
scenes.primary_action: the children strike the first beat and invite their dads onto the circular dance floor
lyrics: Dance with Dad, come dance with me!
scenes.composition: wide establishing frame; fox kit with hand drum at left-thirds focal point, arriving dads framed by the right-side arch, open upper-left title space

scenes.cast: one elephant calf and one elephant dad
scenes.primary_action: calf crouches, then both land one joyful synchronized stomp that lifts a safe arc of sparkling water
scenes.composition: low three-quarter view emphasizing feet and water arc; calf remains the visual leader

scenes.cast: one penguin chick and one penguin dad
scenes.primary_action: chick points the route, then both belly-slide through a curved ribbon lane and stand with flipper follow-through
scenes.composition: side-follow shot with strong left-to-right motion and clear space ahead of the pair

scenes.cast: one fox kit and one fox dad
scenes.primary_action: kit winds up, the pair spin in opposite arcs, and their tails settle a half-beat late
lyrics: Tap your paws upon the ground!
scenes.composition: medium circular composition with the kit on the left power point and Dad on the right

scenes.cast: one joey and one kangaroo dad
scenes.primary_action: joey crouches first, then both bounce over two low flower markers and land together
scenes.composition: wide low-angle arc with generous headroom, landing zone held inside title-safe margins

scenes.cast: one lion cub and one lion dad
scenes.primary_action: cub plays a two-hit hand-drum invitation and Dad answers with a four-step mane-shaking dance
lyrics: Cub and Dad move four quick feet!
scenes.composition: medium-wide stage view; drum is foreground hero, Dad enters from the nearest right edge

scenes.cast: the exact five established animal dad-child pairs
scenes.primary_action: each pair repeats its signature move in a readable stagger, then all travel around the circular floor in one direction
lyrics: Dance with Dad, come dance with me!
scenes.composition: high wide view preserving one clear clockwise parade path; no pair overlaps another

scenes.cast: the exact five established animal dad-child pairs
scenes.primary_action: children give their dads handmade star badges, then everyone performs one final jump and holds the smiling family tableau
lyrics: Side by side, we laugh and play.
scenes.composition: symmetrical earned finale beneath the bunting arch, badges readable, clean end-card space above

quality_gates: opening establishes the festival, children, dads and invitation before the first verse
each animal identity and dad-child size relationship remains consistent
each verse visibly performs anticipation, action, follow-through and settled end state
all structural cuts land on beat or four-beat phrase boundaries
maximum sung-line pace 145 WPM, weighted pace at most 140 WPM, at least 0.4 seconds breathing gap
first-four-second audio above 12 kHz at or below -65 dB RMS and no broadband hiss on full playback
full decode, continuous timeline, final-card-only, contact sheets, transition sheets, waveform, spectrum and truthful thumbnail review
upload remains unauthorized until the exact master and thumbnail are explicitly accepted
